parole.significato: An ammunition belt, worn over the shoulder, having loops or pockets for cartridges.
parole.testo: From earlier form bandollier, from Middle French bandoulliere, from Catalan bandolera, feminine derivative of bandoler (“member of a band of men”), from Catalan bàndol (“band, faction, party”), from Old Spanish bando.
